outcome: No resolution, disproof, or new case of the monomial conjecture (mixed-characteristic, dimension > 3) was found in the window 26 January 2024 to 22 September 2026; the conjecture remains open beyond Hochster's equicharacteristic proof and Heitmann's mixed-characteristic dimension-3 proof.
summary: I searched for any resolution, disproof, or newly-settled case of Hochster's monomial conjecture (the general mixed-characteristic case, dimension > 3, remains open; it is known in equicharacteristic by Hochster's original proof and in mixed characteristic dimension ≤ 3 by Heitmann) since 26 January 2024. Multiple searches for a proof, disproof, or extension to higher dimension in mixed characteristic turned up only pre-2024 literature (Hochster's and Heitmann's own papers, the 'Monomial Conjecture and Order Ideals' papers, the almost-Cohen-Macaulay-via-Fontaine-rings paper) and several 2024-2026 papers on adjacent homological conjectures in mixed characteristic — 'δ-rings, perfectoid towers, and lim Cohen–Macaulay sequences' (arXiv:2509.06527, Sept 2025) and 'Remarks on some Homological Problems regarding Infinite Integral Extensions' (arXiv:2608.09473) — neither of which mentions or proves any case of the monomial conjecture itself; they address the related but distinct positivity-of-intersection-multiplicities conjecture and Ext-module/NBIM-ring conjectures via lim Cohen-Macaulay sequences and perfectoid/contracting-endomorphism techniques. I opened both papers' full text/abstracts directly to confirm this rather than relying on titles. The current Wikipedia article on the monomial conjecture is a stub (flagged as relying on a single source) and states no change to the pre-2024 status. No AI, machine learning, or automated-theorem-proving involvement was found anywhere in this search space; general searches for AI-assisted resolutions of commutative-algebra homological conjectures in 2025-2026 turned up unrelated results (Erdős problems, OEIS conjectures, an unrelated geometry counterexample) with no connection to the monomial conjecture. I also encountered what appear to be spam/AI-generated Zenodo listings ('Monthly Mathematics Conjectures') in one search; I disregarded these as non-authoritative and did not cite them. This matches and confirms the triage's 'none' verdict — I do not disagree with it.
competing_reading: The adjacent 2024-2026 papers on lim Cohen-Macaulay sequences and perfectoid-pure/NBIM rings are close enough in subject matter (they descend from the same Hochster-school homological-conjectures program and use techniques, like Heitmann's, aimed at mixed characteristic) that a looser reading might count them as 'progress' on the broader conjecture family. But under the scope rule (§3.1), these are related problems — they change the question (different conjecture: Serre positivity, Ext-vanishing for NBIM rings) rather than restricting the monomial conjecture's own statement — so they do not count as a case settled or a bound moved on this specific conjecture.
what_would_settle_it: A paper explicitly proving the monomial conjecture (or a specific new dimension/case of it) in mixed characteristic beyond dimension 3, or a preprint/announcement citing Hochster's monomial conjecture by name as its target and stating a settled case.
